links.outcome: Head-to-head sensitivity and specificity of two AI DR algorithms on same patients
links.effect: In 110 patients, sensitivities of Medios and EyeArt were 99% (93%-100%) and 95% (87%-99%); specificities both 88% (73%-97%).
links.quote: In a head-to-head comparison of 110 patients, the sensitivities of Medios and EyeArt were 99% (93%-100%) and 95% (87%-99%).

links.outcome: AI DR detection performance in real-world remote field setting
links.effect: Medios sensitivity 94% (88%-97%) and specificity 94% (88%-98%); EyeArt sensitivity 94% and specificity 86% in field setting.
links.quote: Medios and EyeArt AI algorithms demonstrated high levels of sensitivity and specificity for detecting DR when applied in this real-world field setting.

unlisted_practices: Offline versus online AI deployment in remote outreach screening

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic performance of two deep learning algorithms (Medios and EyeArt) on smartphone fundus photographs collected in a field setting, but images were analyzed retrospectively without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
